title: Obubaka bwa SMS
adminsOnly: Kino kkitundu kkiri ba NetGecko Admin bokka.
jobDescription: Efuga buli lunaku ku ssaawa emu ez'okumakya (EAT). Osobola okwekuba obuliri mu lulyo lwa leero oba okubutuma kakano — ennonkola ezaawezebwa ku loan teziddamu.
previewSummary: Obubaka {{planned}} ku nsimbi {{loans}} ezikebbeddwa. Tewakyali kintu kitutumibwa.
rulesDescription: Ziggyibwa butereevu ku ttendekero lya Airtable erya “SMS”. Kyusa ennonkola eyo — olukalala luno luzza obuggya buli lw'ojja.
logDescription: Obubaka obuwandiikiddwa ku loans (fields za SMS date). Obupya butanika.
confirmContent: Kino kiyituma obubaka obulinobwa leero ku ssimu za balimi ng'okuyita mu Africa's Talking era buwandiikibwa ku loans. Tekisoboka kukyusa.
runError: Omulimu gwa SMS gwannyanirwa. Gezaako nate oba kebba logs za server.
